messages.subject: Ellipses on PCoA
parts:
Hello,

I am trying to make ellipses on a pcoa that are not relating to the population. The ellipses are relating to another grouping but I would like the populations to still be color coded. I have not been able to find a way to keep the populations color coded and add the ellipses. Does any one have an idea on how to do this?

Best,
Liesl Bower-Jernigan

messages.author: b3d929c6746ca81a
messages.subject: RE: [dartR] Ellipses on PCoA
parts:
Hi Liesl,

 

This most likely needs to have some manual handling of the ggplot. The idea is the following

 

Run

 

gl.pcoa.plot(pcoa, gl, save2tmp=TRUE) #with the settings you like and are close to the final figures.

 

p1 <- gl.print.reports(1)  #assuming you have not run a save2tmp before as this stores the plots in your tempfolder and if it is the first time it will be report 1

 

 

Then you can manipulate p1 as a “normal” ggplot using stat_ellipse or geom_ellipse  (package ggforce) to draw it.

 

 

e.g.

 

p1 + geom_ellipse(coordinates and axis+angle of the ellipse)

 

Hope that helps,

 

Cheers, Bernd
